title: clematis grossa var. striatula
intro: Clematis grossa var. striatula, commonly known as Manchurian clematis, is a plant species in the Ranunculaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to alleviate anxiety and insomnia, and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Clematis grossa var. striatula include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions.
